question: Does public series-level or author/API processed RNA link authenticated native EMC cultures and same-normalization other sarcoma cultures well enough for a limited population RNA representation comparison?
conditional_use: Before using a native EMC culture for an NR4A3-program perturbation RNA experiment, determine whether its whole-RNA disease identity resembles native EMC relative to other sarcoma populations more than generic cultured-sarcoma state. This can support inclusion of a culture alongside other authenticated EMC models, or warn that patient-tissue evidence is needed for that experiment. It does not select a universal best model, measure dependency, protein or response, or assert within-donor retention.
prior_art_difference: Source PDC-to-TCGA comparisons already characterize cultured sarcoma models; a linked native EMC population reference is absent from TCGA. R8 targeted-marker profiles and R9 same-donor fidelity no-go did not evaluate whole-profile population representation. Need meaningful addition beyond merely a different similarity statistic before numerical stage.
scientific_gate: Source/control only now. No empirical effect assumed. A processed file alone does not establish value or defensible batch/mixture comparison. Lead and independent novelty/source review required before outcomes.
controls_required: All authenticated EMC culture conditions and known donor reuse: V1-34, USZ22, USZ23, USZ20, NCC where actual expression exists
Same-normalization non-EMC sarcoma PDC controls with direct source histology and treatment/capture/handling labels; names alone insufficient
All13 native EMC tissue conditions plus appropriate native disease controls; six arrays/ten ratio/four3SEQ/twelve TempO retain actual assay/pending scope, not pooled as equivalent units
Explicit gene identifier/length/capture/normalization schema and culture passage/media/treatment; no count cells or gene outputs now
strongest_alternatives: Generic culture adaptation and loss of stromal admixture
Sequencing source/capture/processing batch and transcript annotation
Fusion partner, donor treatment/grade/purity and different sampling conditions
One available culture cannot represent all native EMC models; technical runs are not donors
defeat: No useful source-linked population RNA contrast if processed controls lack authenticated histotypes/conditions or comparable public normalization cannot separate generic culture/capture/mixture from native disease representation. Absence of same-donor tissue or protein does not itself defeat this limited question. If independent value remains generic or already answered, stop before math.
retrieval_plan: First reuse existing ten-GSM GSE221532 metadata, prior identity/method maps and ARCHS4 subset metadata without gene values
One ordinary official GSE221532 series-only brief metadata request to establish exact sample IDs and processed-file declarations
Only genuine linked repository/file/API descriptions if needed; headers/filenames/size only, no full matrix, gene/count cells, raw reads, mechanism paper body or sequence/topology
access: Quiet ordinary public API/files only; no UI/private/bypass/cost/GPU/outreach/publication. Previous unchanged failed routes not repeated. Exact denied FAP-tissue/glycan/HLA/structural-genomics/fusion-forming/topology scopes preserved; no mechanism paper bodies or their sequence/topology.
exposure: Known historical RNA summaries, exploratory hypothesis selection and prior targeted-marker results disclosed; no new RNA outcomes; no blinded discovery claim.
ownership: Only new owned folder; previous freezes immutable; Codex both; root alone integration/push.
